mapper.sql: id, project_id, chapter_id, chapter_number, short_summary, key_events_json, unresolved_questions_json, ending_hook, story_state_snapshot_json, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_summary (project_id, chapter_id, chapter_number, short_summary, key_events_json, unresolved_questions_json, ending_hook, story_state_snapshot_json, status) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterNumber}, #{shortSummary}, #{keyEventsJson}, #{unresolvedQuestionsJson}, #{endingHook}, #{storyStateSnapshotJson}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), chapter_id = VALUES(chapter_id), short_summary = VALUES(short_summary), key_events_json = VALUES(key_events_json), unresolved_questions_json = VALUES(unresolved_questions_json), ending_hook = VALUES(ending_hook), story_state_snapshot_json = VALUES(story_state_snapshot_json), status = VALUES(status)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM story_summary WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND chapter_number = #{chapterNumber}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.chapter_id, s.chapter_number, s.short_summary, s.key_events_json, s.unresolved_questions_json, s.ending_hook, s.story_state_snapshot_json, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM story_summary s JOIN story_chapter c ON c.project_id = s.project_id AND c.id = s.chapter_id AND c.chapter_number = s.chapter_number WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.chapter_number < #{beforeChapter} AND s.status IN ('GENERATED', 'VERIFIED') AND c.status <> 'DIRTY' ORDER BY s.chapter_number DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.chapter_id, s.chapter_number, s.short_summary, s.key_events_json, s.unresolved_questions_json, s.ending_hook, s.story_state_snapshot_json, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM story_summary s JOIN story_chapter c ON c.project_id = s.project_id AND c.id = s.chapter_id AND c.chapter_number = s.chapter_number WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.status IN ('GENERATED', 'VERIFIED') AND c.status <> 'DIRTY' ORDER BY s.chapter_number ASC
